clue.text: Helpless love between one politician and a number appearing before the tory leader

indicators.note: everything so far appears in front of the tory's leading letter, so that letter comes at the end
the love sits between the politician and the number, so it is placed in the middle of those two pieces

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
an MP is a Member of Parliament
ten is a number
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here the start of tory

explanation.surface: A powerless romance sits between a politician and some figure ahead of the Tory chief.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone without power or strength to act is helpless; the word also has a sexual sense not needed here.

clue.text: Had a good meal after the hotel was not acquired

indicators.note: the eating comes after the hotel, so it follows it in the answer

parts.note: an inn is a hotel or hostelry
ate means had a meal

explanation.surface: A guest dined well once the hotel had failed to be bought.
explanation.definitionFit: Inborn qualities are present from birth rather than gained or learned later.

clue.text: Good speed for bad sailor

parts.note: PI, short for pious, is a crossword stand-in for good
rate means speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: A swift good time is offered in place of a hopeless seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: A buccaneer is a seafarer who robs ships, so morally a bad one.

clue.text: One who makes an attempt at going without a decoration is a time-server

indicators.note: the trier goes outside, around the medal, so the decoration sits inside

parts.note: a trier is someone who tries
the MM, Military Medal, is a British military decoration

explanation.surface: Someone striving for an honour is called an opportunist who serves the times.
explanation.definitionFit: An opportunist who shifts views to suit prevailing politics is called both of these, an old political insult.

clue.text: Quality of a loch?

definitions.meaning: the suffix that turns adjectives into nouns of quality, as in kindness

explanation.definitionFit: The suffix forms nouns naming a quality, and it is also the name of a Highland lake.

clue.text: Valued method of election frozen

parts.note: PR is proportional representation, a voting system
iced means frozen

explanation.surface: A treasured voting system has been put on ice.
explanation.definitionFit: Having had a price set on it, something has been valued.

clue.text: A burden to forbear

definitions.meaning: a burden is an old word for the chorus of a song
to forbear is to hold back from doing something

explanation.definitionFit: A song's repeated chorus is called a burden, and holding back from an act is the verbal sense.

clue.text: Parson who has tea without milk?

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
plain, as in tea taken plain, with nothing added

explanation.surface: A vicar takes his cuppa black.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman attached to a regiment, college or hospital serves as a parson.

clue.text: Riding which makes one get into gear before time

indicators.note: the dressing comes before the time in the answer

parts.note: to dress is to put on one's clothes, or gear
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Equestrianism requires suiting up ahead of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gear' means clothing here, not a car's gearbox.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a discipline of horse riding in which the animal performs precise trained movements.

clue.text: Flowers conceal the scars in one

indicators.note: to conceal is to disguise, so the letters of scars in are disguised by rearranging them

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Blooms are used to cover up a single person's scars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conceal' turns SCARS IN into NARCISS; I for 'one' is then added.
explanation.definitionFit: These are daffodils and jonquils, plural of a spring-flowering bulb.

clue.text: Wipe out egghead with a very loud and victorious shot

parts.note: the head of egg is its first letter
ff, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud
an ace is a winning serve in tennis

explanation.surface: An intellectual erases opposition with a loud winning serve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egghead' looks like an intellectual but is read as the head of 'egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase or obliterate something is to wipe it out.

clue.text: Kind of lens used to try to catch a town

parts.note: to fish is to try to catch
Eye is a small market town in Suffolk, England

explanation.surface: Photographic equipment employed when angling near a town.
explanation.walkthrough: EYE is a small town in Suffolk, England.
explanation.definitionFit: A very wide-angle camera lens with a strongly curved front is named after a fish's view.

clue.text: Coming from a mat it is a mat

indicators.note: the answer comes from, is made out of, the letters of the words that follow, rearranged

explanation.surface: Something emerging from a rug turns out to be a rug itself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming from' signals the anagram: A MAT IT rearranges to the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a Japanese straw floor covering, so a kind of mat.

clue.text: In great distances the motor returns wonderful performances

indicators.note: the turned car sits in the middle of the distances

parts.note: miles are great distances

indicators.note: returns means the word for the motor is read backwards

parts.note: a motor is a car

explanation.surface: Over long journeys a car comes back and puts on dazzling shows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' suggests a motorist coming home; it turns the motor round, and 'In' places that inside the distances.
explanation.definitionFit: Astonishing feats or displays, especially seemingly supernatural ones, are wonders.

clue.text: Kept still to have photo taken in colour

indicators.note: the posing goes inside the colour

parts.note: red is a colour
to pose is to sit for a photograph

explanation.surface: Someone stayed motionless to be photographed in colour.
explanation.definitionFit: To have rested, lying quiet and unmoving, is to have stayed still.

clue.text: Liberate a narrow ruler from unorthodoxy

parts.note: to free is to liberate
thin means narrow
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: Releasing a slender monarch from heresy.
explanation.definitionFit: Thinking independently of established religion or doctrine is unorthodoxy.

clue.text: Guiding light which enables seaman to follow Europeans

indicators.note: the seaman follows, coming after the Europeans

parts.note: Poles are people from Poland, Europeans
tar is slang for a sailor

explanation.surface: A beacon lets a sailor keep behind some continental travellers.
explanation.definitionFit: The North Star has long served navigators as a fixed point to steer by.

clue.text: The beautiful appear in remarkably safe romances

indicators.note: the beautiful appear inside the rearranged letters
remarkably means the word safe is rearranged in a striking way

parts.note: the fair are beautiful people

explanation.surface: Good-looking people turn up in surprisingly secure love stories.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remarkably' gives AFES from the clue's 'safe'; 'appear in' places the beautiful inside it, after the first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Love affairs, a French borrowing as in affaires de coeur, are romances.

clue.text: Something in church which makes a politician fight after a proposition

indicators.note: the politician and fight come after the proposition

parts.note: an offer is a proposition
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party
to box is to fight

explanation.surface: A churchgoer's item prompts a Conservative to brawl following a suggestion.
explanation.walkthrough: TORY is a member of Britain's Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A collection receptacle for donations stands in a church.

clue.text: Batting twice in a charity event despite it being bad weather

indicators.note: the two batting words go inside the charity event

parts.note: a rag is a student charity event in Britain

indicators.note: twice means the word for batting is written two times

parts.note: a batsman who is batting is in, in cricket

explanation.surface: A cricketer bats twice at a fundraiser even though it is pouring down.
explanation.walkthrough: RAG is a British student charity fundraising event; IN means batting in cricket. The definition is the state of it pouring, read as a weather condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Water falling from the sky is the bad weather described.

clue.text: Opening inside door if I cease knocking

indicators.note: inside means the letters sit within the words door if I cease

explanation.surface: Someone stops knocking at a door.
explanation.definitionFit: A hole or aperture, such as a mouth or vent, is an opening.

clue.text: A lot of money given for big players, and in France

parts.note: the pack are the large forwards in a rugby team
et is French for and

explanation.surface: A big sum is paid for hefty players, even in France.
explanation.walkthrough: In rugby the forwards, the heavy players, are called the pack.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, a large sum is said to cost a packet.

clue.text: European entry in lexicon or dictionary

indicators.note: an entry in means the letters are found inside the words lexicon or dictionary

explanation.surface: A word from the Continent is listed in a reference book.
explanation.definitionFit: Scandinavians and their neighbours of northern Europe are described this way.

clue.text: Former manual worker includes a judge of intellectual activity

indicators.note: the former worker includes the a, holding it inside

parts.note: ex means former
a miner does manual work

explanation.surface: An ex-miner takes in someone who assesses brainwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'includes' puts A inside EXMINER, after EX.
explanation.definitionFit: One who sets or marks tests assesses learning and mental work.

clue.text: The knight without had a party

indicators.note: without means the word had is removed from the knight's name

parts.note: Sir Galahad is the Arthurian knight
taken as written

explanation.surface: The knight went without and threw a celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Galahad is the Arthurian knight; 'without' removes the clue's 'had' from his name.
explanation.definitionFit: A festive occasion or celebration is a party.

clue.text: Television vehicle for a girl appearing among sailors

indicators.note: the girl appears among the sailors, placed inside them

parts.note: tars are sailors
Di is a girl's name, short for Diana

explanation.surface: A girl is seen with a crew of sailors in a TV show's craft.
explanation.walkthrough: The Doctor's time machine in the British TV series Doctor Who.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the time-travelling police box from Doctor Who, a vehicle seen on television.

clue.text: The old man arrested, became suddenly frightened

parts.note: the old man is slang for one's father, pa
nicked is British slang for arrested

explanation.surface: Father was arrested and took fright.
explanation.definitionFit: To be seized by sudden fear is to be in a state of alarm.

clue.text: Abdicate only for a second during one's rule

indicators.note: the second comes during the rule, inside it

parts.note: a reign is a monarch's period of rule
s is the abbreviation for second

explanation.surface: A monarch gives up the throne for just one moment of their reign.
explanation.definitionFit: To give up a throne or office is to step down.

clue.text: It is grand when a Scot is about to joke with one

indicators.note: the Scot is about, around, the joke and the one

parts.note: Mac, from the common Scottish surname prefix, is a nickname for a Scotsman
to jest is to joke
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Something is splendid when a Scotsman is ready to kid with someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Stately, impressive and dignified are senses of grand.
